topic: The deepest point in the ocean
script: If you dropped Mount Everest into the deepest part of the ocean, its peak would still be about 2 kilometers underwater. That spot, the Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench, is nearly 11,000 meters deep. The water pressure there is more than 1,000 times what we feel at the surface. The first people to reach it were Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh, in 1960. Even there, scientists have found life, including small shrimp-like animals called amphipods.
